app.name: CodeWhale
app.one_liner: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek V4 that streams reasoning blocks, edits local workspaces with approval gates, and includes an auto mode that chooses both model and thinking level per turn.

screens.name: Main TUI Screen
screens.purpose: Display streaming reasoning blocks and proposed code edits with approval gates for user interaction.

rust_commands.name: codewhale
rust_commands.purpose: Dispatcher command that launches the `codewhale-tui` runtime for interactive sessions.

rust_commands.name: codewhale-tui
rust_commands.purpose: Interactive terminal user interface runtime that handles streaming reasoning and edit approvals.

mvp_plan: week 1: Ensure `codewhale` and `codewhale-tui` binaries are co-located during all installation methods
week 1: Implement approval gate for local file edits
week 1: Integrate DeepSeek V4 with dynamic model/thinking-level selection
acceptance_tests: In auto mode, the agent selects different models or reasoning levels across consecutive turns based on task complexity.
User can install via npm and successfully run `codewhale` which launches `codewhale-tui` without errors.
